pageDesc: Manage SillyTavern authentication, network proxy and version settings
authModeTip:
Basic Auth: everyone shares one set of credentials
Multi-User: each user has independent character cards and chat history
basicAuthHint: Everyone uses the same username and password
multiUserHint: Each user has independent character cards and chat history
defaultUserHint: Setting password for default admin user (default-user)
passwordHintBasic: This password is used for Basic Auth login
passwordHintMulti: This password is for the default admin account (default-user) in multi-user mode
passwordMinLength: Password must be at least 8 characters
apiProxyTip: Proxy API requests through a relay. Disable when using domestic APIs (SiliconFlow, Volcengine, DeepSeek, etc.)
versionSectionDesc: Update only the SillyTavern program files. User data (character cards, chats, etc.) is preserved.
gitBranchTip: Tag list fetched from GitHub. Pick a tag and click “Switch version” on the left to apply. To pull the newest official release, use the “Update to latest release” button on the right.
switchVersionMessage: Switch to {version} and redeploy. User data (character cards, chats, etc.) will be preserved. Continue?
switchVersionStarted: Version switch started, server will reinstall
updateMessage: This will pull the latest release version and redeploy. User data will be preserved. Continue?
updateStarted: Update started, server will reinstall automatically
reinstallSectionDesc: Reinstalling will WIPE all files on the server (including character cards, chat history, custom settings) and install the current version from scratch. This action cannot be undone.
reinstallMessage: This will DELETE all files on the server (including character cards, chat history, etc.) and reinstall from scratch. This action cannot be undone.
unsavedMessage: You have unsaved setting changes. Save and restart the server?
saveConfirmMessage: Server will automatically restart after saving. Continue?

llm.desc: A free AI API quota included with this plan, ready to use in SillyTavern.
llm.step1: Go to “API Connections”, set “API” to “Chat Completion” and “Chat Completion Source” to “Custom (OpenAI-compatible)”
llm.step2: Paste the “Base URL” below into “Custom Endpoint”, the “API Key” into “Custom API Key”, then click “Connect”
llm.step3: Once connected, pick any model from the “Available Models” dropdown and start chatting
llm.usageStale: Real-time usage unavailable right now, try again later
